<#if execution.resultStatus == "ERRORED" || execution.resultStatus == "WARNING" || execution.resultStatus == "SUCCESSFUL">
<#assign childAssetTypesStr = "">
<#list result.driftSummary.childAssetTypes as asset>
  <#if asset?index != 0><#assign childAssetTypesStr = childAssetTypesStr + "/"></#if>
  <#assign childAssetTypesStr = childAssetTypesStr + asset.name>
</#list>
<#assign showNames = (execution.resultStatus == "ERRORED" || execution.resultStatus == "WARNING")>
{
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "header",
      "text": {
        "type": "plain_text",
        "text": "<#if execution.resultStatus == 'ERRORED'>:rotating_light: <#elseif execution.resultStatus == 'WARNING'>:warning: <#else>:white_check_mark: </#if>Schema Drift — ${tenant}: ${assets[0].dataSourceName}",
        "emoji": true
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "fields": [
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Asset:*\n${assets[0].name} (${assets[0].assetType.name})" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*Status:*\n${execution.resultStatus}" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*${childAssetTypesStr}(s) Added:*\n${(result.driftSummary.addedCount)!0}" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*${childAssetTypesStr}(s) Modified:*\n${(result.driftSummary.modifiedCount)!0}" },
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "*${childAssetTypesStr}(s) Deleted:*\n${(result.driftSummary.deletedCount)!0}" }
      ]
    }
    <#if showNames && (result.driftSummary.addedNames)?? && (result.driftSummary.addedNames?size > 0)>
    ,
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": ":heavy_plus_sign: *Added (${result.driftSummary.addedNames?size}):* <#list result.driftSummary.addedNames as name>`${name}`<#if name_has_next>, </#if></#list>"
      }
    }
    </#if>
    <#if showNames && (result.driftSummary.modifiedNames)?? && (result.driftSummary.modifiedNames?size > 0)>
    ,
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": ":pencil2: *Modified (${result.driftSummary.modifiedNames?size}):* <#list result.driftSummary.modifiedNames as name>`${name}`<#if name_has_next>, </#if></#list>"
      }
    }
    </#if>
    <#if showNames && (result.driftSummary.deletedNames)?? && (result.driftSummary.deletedNames?size > 0)>
    ,
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": ":heavy_minus_sign: *Deleted (${result.driftSummary.deletedNames?size}):* <#list result.driftSummary.deletedNames as name>`${name}`<#if name_has_next>, </#if></#list>"
      }
    }
    </#if>
    ,
    {
      "type": "context",
      "elements": [
        { "type": "mrkdwn", "text": "Current: ${acceldata_dateFormat(result.driftSummary.rightSnapshotData.createdAt)} | Previous: ${acceldata_dateFormat(result.driftSummary.leftSnapshotData.createdAt)}" }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "actions",
      "elements": [
        {
          "type": "button",
          "text": { "type": "plain_text", "text": "View Details", "emoji": true },
          "url": "${execution.link}"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
</#if>
